items.a: Yes. Amio is free practice for the U.S. citizenship test: civics, reading, writing, speaking and the N-400.

items.q: Is Amio part of USCIS or the government?
items.a: No. Amio, from Pathways USA, is not affiliated with USCIS or the government, and it is not legal advice. The civics questions and answers come from the official USCIS lists.

items.q: Can Amio tell me how to answer the N-400 questions about me?
items.a: No. Amio is not legal advice. We teach what each N-400 question means and how the officer may ask it. If “yes” might be true for you, talk to a lawyer first. Find help in Interview, then Ask a lawyer.
Amio is your AI tutor, not a real person. Amio explains in your language. You answer, read and write in English, like at the interview.

No. Your voice is never recorded or saved. Your phone's browser turns what you say into text. When you practice, only your scores are saved. Questions you ask Amio are saved as text, and only you can see them.

items.q: Do I have to do the lessons in order?
items.a: No. You can open any topic and any lesson. The quick check only suggests where to start.

items.q: Can my class or program see my answers?
items.a: No. A program you join sees the name you gave (or your email) and counts, like lessons done. Never your answers, your notes or your questions to Amio.

items.q: How do I delete my data?
items.a: Go to Me, then Settings, then Delete all my data. It erases your saved data and clears this phone. Messages you sent with Contact us stay in our inbox until you ask us to delete them.
